text: For which cardinalities does a finite field exist?
explanation: For each prime power pⁿ there is a field 𝔽_pⁿ, unique up to isomorphism, and no other sizes occur. Composite non-prime-power moduli fail: ℤ/6ℤ has zero divisors (2·3 = 0), and any finite field is a vector space over its prime subfield 𝔽_p, forcing order pⁿ.
